breaks.test_method: migration round trip script (check_script below), run from backend/ under scripts/test-lock.sh run stack 8.14 -- ; it exits 1 with "after Down: index is 'CREATE INDEX \"IX_Disputes_SlaWarning\" ... (\"SlaDueAtUtc\")'"
breaks.check_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 8.14 migration round trip: apply all, Down to AddSlaWarning, compare with the pre-8.14 schema, Up again.
# Run from backend/ of a (throwaway) copy. Exits non-zero when any comparison differs.
set -euo pipefail
NAME=disputedesk-8.14-roundtrip
PORT=${PORT:-55414}
docker rm -f "$NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
docker run -d --name "$NAME" -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=pw -p "$PORT:5432" postgres:18.6-alpine >/dev/null
trap 'docker rm -f "$NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
until docker exec "$NAME" pg_isready -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done
sleep 1
CONN="Host=localhost;Port=$PORT;Database=roundtrip;Username=postgres;Password=pw"
EF=(dotnet ef database update --project src/DisputeDesk.Infrastructure --startup-project src/DisputeDesk.Api --connection "$CONN")
q() { docker exec "$NAME" psql -U postgres -d roundtrip -At -c "$1"; }
COLUMN="select column_name||' '||data_type||' '||is_nullable from information_schema.columns where table_name='Disputes' and column_name='SlaWarningRaisedAtUtc'"
INDEX="select indexdef from pg_indexes where tablename='Disputes' and indexname='IX_Disputes_SlaWarning'"
EXPECT_COLUMN='SlaWarningRaisedAtUtc timestamp with time zone YES'
EXPECT_INDEX='CREATE INDEX "IX_Disputes_SlaWarning" ON public."Disputes" USING btree ("SlaDueAtUtc") WHERE (("SlaWarningRaisedAtUtc" IS NULL) AND ("Status" = ANY (ARRAY['"'"'Submitted'"'"'::text, '"'"'UnderReview'"'"'::text])))'

"${EF[@]}" >/dev/null
[[ -z "$(q "$COLUMN")" && -z "$(q "$INDEX")" ]] || { echo "after Up: column or index still present"; exit 1; }
echo "after all migrations: column and index absent"

"${EF[@]}" AddSlaWarning >/dev/null
[[ "$(q "$COLUMN")" == "$EXPECT_COLUMN" ]] || { echo "after Down: column is '$(q "$COLUMN")'"; exit 1; }
[[ "$(q "$INDEX")" == "$EXPECT_INDEX" ]] || { echo "after Down: index is '$(q "$INDEX")'"; exit 1; }
echo "after Down (database update AddSlaWarning): column and partial index restored as AddSlaWarning created them"

"${EF[@]}" >/dev/null
[[ -z "$(q "$COLUMN")" && -z "$(q "$INDEX")" ]] || { echo "after Up again: column or index still present"; exit 1; }
echo "after Up again: column and index absent"
